9.2.2.1.4 Interfaces for Suspend-to-Ram Notifications
The
S2RHub
provides means for a
State Management
implementation or an
SM-
ControlApplication
to request entering or leaving a "prepared for Suspend-to-
RAM" state from Adaptive Applications implementing
S2RSatellite
.
S2RHub
is not
intended to be used by regular
Adaptive Application
s.
S2RSatellite
provides means for any Adaptive Application to be notified to enter- or
leave the process-local "prepared for Suspend-to-RAM" state. If the state is entered,
the Adaptive Application should prepare to be suspend by the operating system at
anytime. This could be a storage of persistent data, the stop of offering services, the
stop of any safety activities, etc.
